messages.text:
I ordered one of the 4Dsky units and I accidentally ordered the Canada/LATAM/AU version when I meant to purchase the USA Standard + bonus antenna.

Is there a way to change it before it ships?
Yes, as long as it hasn't shipped we can change the variant. What's your order number, and the name or postcode ····?
Handed to the team · Swap blocked: target variant 66206UATRNE unavailable with no confirmed date.

Good news, Dave, nothing has shipped yet, so the region can still be changed.

The catch: the USA Standard + Bonus Antenna version is sold out right now and I don't have a confirmed date for it, so I can't move your order onto it myself today. I've put this in front of Abel and Georges to sort the swap and the $95 price difference. Stay in the chat, one of them will jump in here, and you'll get it by email if you step away.
Before you go, one thing: you'd been eyeing the Airsquitter for a while, what finally made you order it when you did?
Saw the hobbyist miner interview and decided to go for it
What was it in that interview that tipped you over? Curious whether it was the tracking range or the points side of it.
More of the points but like the utility of it, I have a Geonet unit too
Makes sense. With the Geonet already running, what's that one actually given you so far, points aside?
It has paid itself off already so just all profits for the last 6 months

That's a good run. Thanks for telling me, Dave, genuinely useful to hear.

Abel or Georges will pick up the region swap on your order from here.

Any time. The swap is still open with the team, so I'll leave the review ask for another day.

If you want help with anything else, I'm here. You're also welcome in our Discord for product news and setup help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
